messages:
mina (newhire): hey all :wave: i accepted the GitHub invite but the org still doesn't show on my profile and private repos 404. invite link shows "This invite is no longer valid". i tried the link in two browsers. who should i ping for a resend?
it-support: welcome! what email did you accept with and what's your GH username? we use SAML + SCIM provisioning so sometimes org membership is delayed until SCIM sync or email match.
mina (newhire): used mina+work@gmail.com, username is minadev. i signed in with my personal account before accepting, maybe that messed it up.
devex: common issue. quick steps: 1) sign out of other GH accounts or use incognito, 2) run `gh auth status` to confirm which account is active, 3) if you have multiple GH accounts the invite must be accepted while logged into the matching one.
it-support: resending invite now and forcing SSO handshake. note: if SCIM provisioning is enabled the org may add you automatically after SSO complete. if you still see 404, reply with the exact error page and we'll do a manual add.
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist reminder: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA + save recovery codes 4) Add SSH key. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
mina (newhire): got the new invite email, accepted in incognito as minadev but SSO redirect failed with "No provisioning match for email". i used a personal legacy email in GH settings years ago.
it-support: that error means your GitHub account email doesn't match the invite email. two options: A) add mina+work@gmail.com to your GH account and verify it, then accept invite; B) we can change the invite email to the primary address on your GH account (admin-side). which do you prefer?
mina (newhire): i'll add the work email to my GH account and verify. one sec.
mina (newhire): added and verified the work email, re-accepted invite, SSO prompted for 2FA and i set up TOTP. now i can see the org but i don't have access to private repos.
it-support: good progress. per default we give new hires read+PR on code repos. private infra repos require manager approval + short security checklist. tagging @court for approval.
court (manager): approved: mina needs read access to private-models and infra-docs for first-week ramp. please add to team "eng-core".
github-bot: Added mina (minadev) to team eng-core with membership type: member. Granted repo-level permissions: private-models (read), infra-docs (read).
devex: tip: to verify your SSH key, run `ssh -T git@github.com` — if it says "Hi minadev!" you are good. also if you want push rights later request it in the short form with manager sign-off.
mina (newhire): `ssh -T` worked and i can clone private-models. opened a tiny PR to fix a doc link. thanks everyone :tada:
it-support: closing thread — if anything else pops up ping #help or DM us. :white_check_mark:
